narrative.summary: Chad has no AI-specific law or published AI strategy. Its framework rests on the 2015 personal data protection law (Law 007/PR/2015), listed as in force by the electronic communications regulator. A Directorate-General for AI and a national digital transformation and AI strategy for 2026-2031, being prepared with UNDP support, have no published official text.

Presidency of the Republic of Chad
narrative.review_notes: Not yet verified from the official text: the full text of the 2015 personal data protection law and its 2019 implementing decree, the October 2025 decree creating the Directorate-General for AI, and the national digital transformation and AI strategy 2026-2031. Official sources checked on 18 October 2026 include the Presidency, the telecoms regulator and the digital development agency. Not yet verified from the official text: material from the official gazette, the data protection and cyber authority, the digital ministry, the government and the National Assembly.

instruments.current_status: Listed as a law in force on the official page of the electronic communications regulator (ARCEP), alongside Law 006/PR/2015 creating ANSICE (the national IT security and electronic certification agency) and Law 009/PR/2015 on cybersecurity. Its promulgation date and implementing decree are not yet verified from official sources. Chad has no AI-specific law.
instruments.summary: Chad's general personal data protection law, part of the 2015 package of digital laws (with laws on ANSICE, electronic transactions and cybersecurity) listed by the national electronic communications regulator. It sets the legal framework for processing personal data in Chad and so governs data used to train and run AI systems.
